units.source_text: 大家抬头仰望，齐声欢呼。

en.t: Everyone looked up and cheered in unison.

units.source_text: 她们看到晒台上闪过一个穿浴衣的汉子。

en.t: They saw a man in a yukata briefly appear on the drying platform.

units.source_text: 旅馆建在溪流边的斜坡上。

en.t: The inn was built on a slope beside the mountain stream.

units.source_text: 同外面的正门是水平的，后边的晒台矮得人们都可以跳上去。

en.t: It was level with the front gate outside, while the drying platform at the back was low enough for people to jump up onto it.

units.source_text: 闪现的汉子好不容易把晃荡的脚搭在圆木柱子上，笨拙地使劲往上爬。

en.t: The man who had appeared at last managed to set his dangling foot on a round wooden post and clumsily hauled himself upward.
